title: Preserve file-change visibility for a named worktree when opening attribution is withheld
outcome: A withheld or drifted multi-root turn keeps the appropriate named worktree visible to the file watcher as a location, without granting source or check attribution.
acceptance: A deterministic fixture exercises a multi-root opening with a named worktree below an ignored parent, then withholds attribution or changes the opening identity. An eligible edit or removal under that root still reaches the turn file-change projection.
The producer outcome remains free of source changes, sightings and attributed checks for the withheld opening. Existing queued subtree-coverage latching and single-root behavior are preserved.
